if (nav && nav.parentElement !== document.documentElement) {
document.documentElement.appendChild(nav);
}
}
attachBottomNav();
window.addEventListener("pageshow", attachBottomNav);
})();

<section class="info-panel">
<h1>الأسئلة الشائعة</h1>
<details><summary>كيف أضيف منتجاً إلى السلة؟</summary><p>اضغط على زر «أضف إلى السلة» في بطاقة المنتج، وستظهر رسالة تأكيد الإضافة.</p></details>
<details><summary>كيف أرسل طلبي؟</summary><p>افتح السلة وراجع المنتجات والكميات والإجمالي، ثم اضغط «إتمام الطلب عبر واتساب» لإرسال تفاصيل الطلب.</p></details>
<details><summary>هل يمكن حذف منتج من السلة؟</summary><p>نعم، يمكنك استخدام زر الحذف داخل السلة، أو تقليل الكمية حتى تصل إلى صفر.</p></details>
<details><summary>هل المنتجات الرقمية قابلة للاسترجاع؟</summary><p>يرجى فتح «عرض جميع تفاصيل الباقة» والاطلاع على الشروط والأحكام الموجودة في نهاية التفاصيل قبل الشراء.</p></details>
<details><summary>هل الاشتراكات رسمية وآمنة؟</summary><p>نعم، آمنة 100% ومصرّحة بشهادة من شركة أبل، ولا تضر جهازك ولا تخرجه من الضمان ولا تكسر حمايته.</p></details>
<details><summary>هل التفعيل فوري؟</summary><p>نعم، بعد إتمام الدفع تستلم كود التفعيل خلال دقيقة واحدة وتفعّله بنفسك مباشرة بدون انتظار.</p></details>
<details><summary>كم مدة تسليم الطلب وكيف أستلمه؟</summary><p>التسليم فوري وتلقائي - يوصلك الكود وشرح الخدمة برسالة نصية وعلى رقمك في واتساب.</p></details>

function iconUrl(slug) {
return "https://cdn.simpleicons.org/" + slug;
}
function createAppIcon(app,sectionId) {
const [name,slug] = app;
const lightIcon = ["tiktok","x"].includes(slug) ? "app-icon-light" : "";
return `
<div class="app-item">
<div class="app-icon ${lightIcon}">
<img src="${iconUrl(slug)}" alt="${name}" loading="lazy"
onerror="this.style.display='none';this.parentElement.textContent='${name.slice(0,1)}';">
</div>
<span class="app-name">${name}</span>
</div>
`;
}
function escapeHTML(value) {
return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(char) {
return {
"&":"&amp;",
"<":"&lt;",
">":"&gt;",
'"':"&quot;",
"'":"&#39;"
}[char];
});
}

 renderJokerShowroom();

function renderJokerShowroom(){
 const box=document.getElementById("jokerShowroomProducts");
 if(!box)return;
 const products=(Array.isArray(storeItemsCache)?storeItemsCache:[]).filter(item=>item&&item.available!==false).slice(0,3);
 if(!products.length){box.innerHTML='<p class="account-hint">ستظهر المختارات هنا عند توفر المنتجات.</p>';return;}
 box.innerHTML=products.map(item=>createService(item,{compact:true})).join("");
}
function renderJokerCommandCenter(){
 const pairs=[["jokerCommandOrders","statOrders"],["jokerCommandRevenue","statRevenue"],["jokerCommandPending","statPending"],["jokerCommandCustomers","statCustomers"]];
 pairs.forEach(([target,source])=>{const out=document.getElementById(target),input=document.getElementById(source);if(out&&input)out.textContent=input.textContent||"—";});
 const activity=document.getElementById("jokerCommandActivity");
 if(activity){const rows=Array.isArray(adminOrdersCache)?adminOrdersCache:[];if(rows.length){const latest=rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.created_at||0)-new Date(a.created_at||0))[0];activity.textContent="آخر نشاط مسجل: الطلب #"+String(latest.order_number||"—")+" · "+String(latest.status||"حالة غير محددة");}else{activity.textContent="لا توجد طلبات مسجلة لعرض نشاط حديث.";}}
}
function openInfoPage(pageId) {
["storePage","packagesPage","noticePage","faqPage","refundPage","ordersPage","searchPage","notificationsPage","adminPage","storeRegionsPage","storeRegionItemsPage","jokerPrivateShowroomPage","snapArcProductPage","gameZoneProductsPage","gta6DetailsPage"].forEach(id => {
const node = document.getElementById(id);
if(node) node.hidden = id !== pageId;
});
const activePage=document.getElementById(pageId);
if(activePage){activePage.classList.remove("joker-page-enter");void activePage.offsetWidth;activePage.classList.add("joker-page-enter");}
const corridor=document.getElementById("jokerTransitionCorridor");
if(corridor){corridor.classList.remove("is-active");void corridor.offsetWidth;corridor.classList.add("is-active");window.setTimeout(()=>corridor.classList.remove("is-active"),620);}
window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"instant"});
}
function closeInfoPage() {
["packagesPage","noticePage","faqPage","refundPage","ordersPage","searchPage","notificationsPage","adminPage","storeRegionsPage","storeRegionItemsPage","jokerPrivateShowroomPage","snapArcProductPage","gameZoneProductsPage","gta6DetailsPage"].forEach(id => {
const node = document.getElementById(id);
if(node) node.hidden = true;
});
document.getElementById("storePage").hidden = false;
window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"instant"});
setActiveNav("home");
}
let cartToastTimer = null;
function showCartToast() {
const toast = document.getElementById("cartToast");
if(!toast) return;
toast.classList.add("show");
if(cartToastTimer) clearTimeout(cartToastTimer);
cartToastTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove("show"),1900);
}
function productImageList(item) {
let source = item.image_urls ?? item.images ?? item.gallery ?? item.image_url ?? item.image ?? "";
if(typeof source === "string") {
const raw = source.trim();
if(/^data:image\//i.test(raw)) {
source = [raw];
} else if(raw.startsWith("[")) {
try { source = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(error) { source = raw; }
} else {
source = raw ? raw.split(/[,\\n]/).map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
}
}
if(!Array.isArray(source)) source = source ? [source] : [];
return [...new Set(source.map(entry => {
if(typeof entry === "string") return entry.trim();
if(entry && typeof entry === "object") return String(entry.url || entry.image_url || entry.src || "").trim();
return "";
}).filter(url => /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) || /^data:image\//i.test(url)))];
}
function productImageFallback(img, amount) {
if(!img || img.dataset.fallbackApplied === "true") return;
img.dataset.fallbackApplied = "true";
const value = Number(amount);
const fallback = value && typeof PSN_USA_IMGS !== "undefined"
? (PSN_USA_IMGS[value] || createPSNUSACardArtwork(value))
: (typeof PSN_CARD_IMG !== "undefined" ? PSN_CARD_IMG : "");
if(fallback && img.src !== fallback) img.src = fallback;
else img.onerror = null;
}
function createProductGallery(item) {
let images = productImageList(item);
const amount = Number(item && item.amount);
if(!images.length && amount) {
images = [PSN_USA_IMGS[amount] || createPSNUSACardArtwork(amount)];
}
if(!images.length) return "";
const safeImages = images.map(escapeHTML);
const fallbackAmount = amount || 0;
return `
<div class="product-gallery">
<img class="product-gallery-main" src="${safeImages[0]}" alt="${escapeHTML(item.title || "صورة المنتج")}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" fetchpriority="low" onerror="productImageFallback(this,${fallbackAmount})">
${safeImages.length > 1 ? `<div class="product-gallery-thumbs">
${safeImages.map((url,index) => `<button class="product-gallery-thumb ${index === 0 ? "active" : ""}" type="button" data-image="${url}" aria-label="عرض الصورة ${index+1}" onclick="selectProductGalleryImage(this)"><img src="${url}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" fetchpriority="low" onerror="productImageFallback(this,${fallbackAmount})"></button>`).join("")}
</div>` : ""}
</div>
`;
}
function selectProductGalleryImage(button) {
const gallery = button.closest(".product-gallery");
if(!gallery) return;
const main = gallery.querySelector(".product-gallery-main");
if(main) main.src = button.dataset.image || "";
gallery.querySelectorAll(".product-gallery-thumb").forEach(node => node.classList.toggle("active",node === button));
}
function whatsappLink(item) {
const title = item.title || "طلب من متجر JOKER PLUS";
const price = item.price ? " - السعر: " + item.price + " د.ك" : "";
const message = "السلام عليكم، أريد طلب: " + title + price;
return "https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP_NUMBER + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(message);
}
async function shareContent(title,text,url) {
const payload = {title,text,url};
try {
if(navigator.share) {
await navigator.share(payload);
return;
}
} catch(error) {
if(error && error.name === "AbortError") return;
}
try {
await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
showActionToast("✓ تم نسخ الرابط");
} catch(error) {
window.prompt("انسخ الرابط:",url);
}
}
function shareStore() {
shareContent("JOKER PLUS","تفضل بزيارة متجر JOKER PLUS",window.location.href);
}
function shareProduct(button) {
const title = button.dataset.productTitle || "منتج من JOKER PLUS";
const id = button.dataset.productId || "";
const url = new URL(window.location.href);
if(id) url.searchParams.set("product",id);
shareContent(title,"شاهد هذا المنتج في متجر JOKER PLUS: " + title,url.toString());
}
function showActionToast(message) {
const toast = document.getElementById("cartToast");
if(!toast) return;
toast.textContent = message;
toast.classList.add("show");
window.setTimeout(() => {
toast.classList.remove("show");
toast.textContent = "✓ تمت إضافة المنتج إلى السلة";
},2200);
}

function openAccount() {

if(!modal) return;
modal.hidden = false;

}
function closeAccount(event) {

}
async function refreshAccountState() {
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
if(error) throw error;
const user = data?.session?.user;
customerLoggedIn = !!user;
customerHasPhone = !!(user && (user.user_metadata?.phone || user.phone));
document.getElementById("accountSignedIn").hidden = !user;
document.getElementById("accountForm").hidden = !!user;
if(user) {
document.getElementById("accountEmail").textContent = user.email || "حساب العميل";
document.getElementById("accountNameInput").value = user.user_metadata?.full_name || "";
document.getElementById("accountPhoneInput").value = user.phone ? formatPhoneWithCode(user.phone) : (user.user_metadata?.phone ? formatPhoneWithCode(user.user_metadata.phone) : "+");
const avatar = user.user_metadata?.avatar_url;
document.getElementById("accountAvatarPreview").src = avatar || DEFAULT_AVATAR;
setToolAvatar(avatar);
}
} catch(error) {
if(status) status.textContent = "تعذر التحقق من الحساب حالياً.";
}
}
async function saveCustomerProfile() {
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
const full_name = document.getElementById("accountNameInput").value.trim();
let phone = document.getElementById("accountPhoneInput").value.trim();
phone = phone.replace(/[\s()-]/g,"");
if(!/^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(phone)) {
  status.textContent = "أدخل رقم هاتف صحيحاً مع مفتاح الدولة، مثال: +965XXXXXXXX.";
  document.getElementById("accountPhoneInput").focus();
  return;
}
status.textContent = "جارٍ حفظ بياناتك...";
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.auth.updateUser({data:{full_name,phone}});
if(error) throw error;
status.textContent = "تم حفظ بيانات الحساب بنجاح.";
if(data?.user) {
document.getElementById("accountEmail").textContent = data.user.email || "حساب العميل";
customerHasPhone = true;
}
} catch(error) {
status.textContent = error.message || "تعذر حفظ البيانات حالياً.";
}
}
async function uploadCustomerAvatar(file) {
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
if(!file) return;
if(!["image/jpeg","image/png","image/webp"].includes(file.type)) {
status.textContent = "اختر صورة بصيغة JPG أو PNG أو WEBP.";
return;
}
if(file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
status.textContent = "حجم الصورة يجب ألا يتجاوز 5 ميجابايت.";
return;
}
status.textContent = "جارٍ رفع الصورة الشخصية...";
try {
const {data:sessionData,error:sessionError} = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
if(sessionError) throw sessionError;
const user = sessionData?.session?.user;
if(!user) throw new Error("سجّل الدخول أولاً.");
const extension = file.type === "image/png" ? "png" : file.type === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpg";
const path = user.id + "/avatar-" + Date.now() + "." + extension;
const {error:uploadError} = await supabaseClient.storage.from("avatars").upload(path,file,{upsert:true,contentType:file.type});
if(uploadError) throw uploadError;
const {data:publicData} = supabaseClient.storage.from("avatars").getPublicUrl(path);
const avatar_url = publicData?.publicUrl;
if(!avatar_url) throw new Error("تعذر الحصول على رابط الصورة.");
const {error:updateError} = await supabaseClient.auth.updateUser({data:{avatar_url}});
if(updateError) throw updateError;
document.getElementById("accountAvatarPreview").src = avatar_url;
setToolAvatar(avatar_url);
status.textContent = "تم تحديث الصورة الشخصية بنجاح.";
} catch(error) {
status.textContent = error.message || "تعذر رفع الصورة. تأكد من إعداد Storage وإنشاء bucket باسم avatars.";
}
}
async function loadCustomerOrders() {
const container = document.getElementById("customerOrders");
if(!container) return;
container.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">جارٍ تحميل طلباتك...</p>';
try {
const {data:sessionData,error:sessionError} = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
if(sessionError) throw sessionError;
const user = sessionData?.session?.user;
if(!user) {
container.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">سجّل الدخول لعرض طلباتك.</p><button type="button" class="joker-orders-login" onclick="openAccount()">تسجيل الدخول</button>';
return;
}
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.from("orders").select("*").eq("user_id",user.id).order("created_at",{ascending:false}).limit(30);
if(error) throw error;
const approvedOrders = data || [];
let codesByOrder = {};
try {
const codesResult = await supabaseClient.from("snap_codes").select("code,package,order_number").eq("user_id",user.id).eq("status","sold");
if(!codesResult.error) (codesResult.data || []).forEach(c => { const k = String(c.order_number || ""); (codesByOrder[k] = codesByOrder[k] || []).push(c); });
} catch(_) {}
let appCodesByOrder = {};
try {
const orderNumbers = approvedOrders.map(o => String(o.order_number || o.id || "")).filter(Boolean);
if(orderNumbers.length){
const appCodesResult = await supabaseClient.from("app_plus_codes").select("code,app_name,order_number").eq("status","sold").in("order_number",orderNumbers);
if(!appCodesResult.error) (appCodesResult.data || []).forEach(c => { const k=String(c.order_number||""); (appCodesByOrder[k]=appCodesByOrder[k]||[]).push(c); });
}
} catch(_) {}
try { const k="jokerPlusOrderStatuses_"+user.id, prev=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||"{}"), now={}; approvedOrders.forEach(o=>{const n=String(o.order_number||o.id||""),st=String(o.status||"");now[n]=st;if(prev[n]&&prev[n]!==st){try{window.jokerStoreNotification({title:"تحديث حالة الطلب #"+n,body:st,created_at:new Date().toISOString(),order_number:n});}catch(_){}if("Notification" in window&&Notification.permission==="granted")new Notification("تحديث طلبك من JOKER PLUS",{body:st})}});localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(now)); } catch(_) {}
try { if(typeof window.jokerMarkOrdersSeen==="function") window.jokerMarkOrdersSeen(user.id,approvedOrders); } catch(_) {}
// مصدر «طلباتي» هو قاعدة البيانات فقط؛ لا نعرض نسخة محلية احتياطية
// حتى لا يعود الطلب للظهور بعد أن تحذفه الإدارة من قاعدة البيانات.
try { localStorage.removeItem("jokerPlusLocalPendingOrder_" + user.id); } catch(_) {}
const ordersToRender = approvedOrders;
if(!ordersToRender.length) {
container.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">ما عندك طلبات مسجلة حالياً.</p>';
return;
}
container.innerHTML = ordersToRender.map(order => {
const number = order.order_number || order.id || "—";
const total = order.total ?? order.total_amount ?? order.amount ?? "—";
const rawStatus = String(order.status || "");
const isRejected = /ملغ|رفض|فشل|cancel|reject|fail/i.test(rawStatus);
const isCompleted = /تم\s*التنفيذ|مكتمل|completed|fulfilled|success/i.test(rawStatus);
const isProcessing = /قيد\s*التنفيذ|تم التأكيد|تمت الموافقة|approved|processing/i.test(rawStatus) && !isCompleted;
const isApprovedOrProcessing = isProcessing || /منفذ/i.test(rawStatus) || isCompleted;
const isPending = !isRejected && !isApprovedOrProcessing;
const statusText = isPending ? "جاري تأكيد طلبك من الإدارة" : rawStatus;
const date = order.created_at ? new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleDateString("ar-KW",{weekday:"long",day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"}) : "—";
const totalNumber = Number(total);
const totalText = isNaN(totalNumber) ? String(total) : totalNumber.toFixed(2) + " د.ك";
const stateClass = isCompleted ? " done" : (isProcessing ? " processing" : (/ملغ|رفض|فشل/.test(String(statusText)) ? " cancel" : ""));
return '<article class="joker-order-card">' +
'<div class="joker-order-row" style="align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px"><span class="joker-order-label" style="font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.4px;color:#d9b8f4">JOKER PLUS · ' + (isPending ? 'طلبك محفوظ' : 'متابعة الطلب') + '</span><span class="joker-order-state' + stateClass + '" style="font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;flex:none">' + (isCompleted ? 'طلبك تم وانتهى 💜' : (isPending ? 'بانتظار الاعتماد' : 'جاري العمل على طلبك 💛')) + '</span></div>' +
'<div class="joker-order-row"><span class="joker-order-label">رقم الطلب:</span><span class="joker-order-value" dir="ltr">#' + escapeHTML(String(number)) + '</span></div>' +
'<div class="joker-order-row"><span class="joker-order-label">حالة الطلب:</span><span class="joker-order-state' + stateClass + '">' + escapeHTML(String(statusText)) + '</span></div>' +
'<div class="joker-order-row"><span class="joker-order-label">المجموع:</span><span class="joker-order-value">' + escapeHTML(totalText) + '</span></div>' +
'<div class="joker-order-row"><span class="joker-order-label">تاريخ الطلب:</span><span class="joker-order-value">' + escapeHTML(date) + '</span></div>' +
(typeof jokerSnapCodesHTML === "function" ? jokerSnapCodesHTML(codesByOrder[String(number)]) : '') +
(appCodesByOrder[String(number)] && appCodesByOrder[String(number)].length ? '<div class="jk-codes-box"><div class="jk-codes-title">🔑 أكواد تطبيقات بلس الخاصة بطلبك</div>'+appCodesByOrder[String(number)].map((c,ci)=>'<div class="jk-code-item"><span class="jk-code-pkg">'+escapeHTML(jokerAppCodeLabels(order,appCodesByOrder[String(number)])[ci]||'')+'</span><code class="jk-code-value" dir="ltr">'+escapeHTML(String(c.code||''))+'</code><button type="button" class="jk-code-copy" data-code="'+escapeHTML(String(c.code||''))+'" onclick="copySnapCode(this)">نسخ الكود</button></div>').join('')+'</div>' : '') +
(isCompleted ? '<button type="button" class="joker-reorder-btn" data-items="' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(order.items) ? order.items : (Array.isArray(order.order_items) ? order.order_items : []))) + '" onclick="reorderCustomerOrder(this)">إعادة طلب المنتجات</button>' : '') +
'</article>';
}).join("");
} catch(error) {
console.warn("JOKER PLUS orders:",error);
container.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">تعذر تحميل الطلبات.<br><small dir="ltr">' + escapeHTML(String((error && (error.message || error.code)) || error)) + '</small></p>';
}
}
const PHONE_COUNTRY_CODES = (function() {
const set = new Set(["1","7","20","27","30","31","32","33","34","36","39","40","41","43","44","45","46","47","48","49","51","52","53","54","55","56","57","58","60","61","62","63","64","65","66","81","82","84","86","90","91","92","93","94","95","98","211","212","213","216","218","290","291","297","298","299","420","421","423","850","852","853","855","856","870","880","886","992","993","994","995","996","998"]);
const ranges = [[220,258],[260,269],[350,359],[370,389],[500,509],[590,599],[670,692],[960,968],[970,977]];
ranges.forEach(function(r) {for(let n = r[0]; n <= r[1]; n++) set.add(String(n));});
return set;
})();
function formatPhoneWithCode(value) {
const digits = String(value || "").replace(/[^0-9]/g,"");
for(let len = 1; len <= 3; len++) {
const code = digits.slice(0,len);
if(digits.length >= len && PHONE_COUNTRY_CODES.has(code)) {
const rest = digits.slice(len);
return "+" + code + (rest ? " " + rest : "");
}
}
return "+" + digits;
}

event.target.value = formatPhoneWithCode(event.target.value);
}
});
document.addEventListener("change",function(event) {
if(event.target && event.target.id === "accountAvatarInput") {
uploadCustomerAvatar(event.target.files?.[0]);
event.target.value = "";
}
});

let jokerAuthCountry = JOKER_GULF_COUNTRIES[0];
function renderAuthCountry() {
const flag = document.getElementById("jokerCountryFlag");
const dial = document.getElementById("jokerCountryDial");
const input = document.getElementById("jokerAuthPhone");
if(flag) flag.innerHTML = jokerAuthCountry.flag;
if(dial) dial.textContent = "+" + jokerAuthCountry.dial;
if(input) {
  input.maxLength = jokerAuthCountry.len + 1;
  input.placeholder = "X".repeat(jokerAuthCountry.len);
}
const list = document.getElementById("jokerCountryList");
if(list) Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.children, function(li) {li.classList.toggle("is-active", li.dataset.id === jokerAuthCountry.id);});
}
function toggleCountryList(open) {
const list = document.getElementById("jokerCountryList");
const btn = document.getElementById("jokerCountryBtn");
if(!list || !btn) return;
const show = typeof open === "boolean" ? open : list.hidden;
list.hidden = !show;
btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", show ? "true" : "false");
}
function initAuthCountries() {
const list = document.getElementById("jokerCountryList");
if(!list) return;
list.innerHTML = JOKER_GULF_COUNTRIES.map(function(c) {
  return '<li role="option" data-id="' + c.id + '">' + c.flag + '<span class="jc-name">' + c.name + '</span><span class="jc-dial">+' + c.dial + '</span></li>';
}).join("");
renderAuthCountry();
}
function bindAuthCountryEvents() {
const btn = document.getElementById("jokerCountryBtn");
const list = document.getElementById("jokerCountryList");
const box = document.querySelector("#accountModal .account-box");
if(btn) btn.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  toggleCountryList();
});
if(list) list.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
  event.stopPropagation();
  const li = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest("li") : null;
  if(!li) return;
  const found = JOKER_GULF_COUNTRIES.filter(function(c) {return c.id === li.dataset.id;})[0];
  if(found) jokerAuthCountry = found;
  renderAuthCountry();
  toggleCountryList(false);
  const input = document.getElementById("jokerAuthPhone");
  if(input) input.focus();
});
// النافذة توقف انتشار النقرات (stopPropagation) لذلك نربط الإغلاق على الصندوق نفسه
if(box) box.addEventListener("click", function() {toggleCountryList(false);});
}
function startAuthCountries() {
initAuthCountries();
bindAuthCountryEvents();
}
if(document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", startAuthCountries);
else startAuthCountries();
document.addEventListener("input", function(event) {
if(event.target && event.target.id === "jokerAuthPhone") {
  event.target.value = event.target.value
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function(d) {return String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 1632);})
    .replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
}
});
function readAuthPhone() {
const input = document.getElementById("jokerAuthPhone");
let digits = String(input && input.value || "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
const dial = jokerAuthCountry.dial;
if(digits.indexOf(dial) === 0 && digits.length > jokerAuthCountry.len) digits = digits.slice(dial.length);
digits = digits.replace(/^0+/, "");
return {digits: digits, valid: digits.length === jokerAuthCountry.len, phone: "+" + dial + digits};
}
async function signInWithProvider(provider) {
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
if(provider !== "google") return;
status.textContent = "جارٍ تحويلك إلى Google...";
try {
  const {error} = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: "google",
    options: {redirectTo: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname}
  });
  if(error) throw error;
} catch(error) {
  status.textContent = error.message || "تعذر بدء تسجيل الدخول باستخدام Google.";
}
}
async function submitAccount(event) {
event.preventDefault();
const email = document.getElementById("accountEmailInput").value.trim();
const password = document.getElementById("accountPasswordInput").value;
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
const btn = document.getElementById("jokerSigninButton");
const phoneInput = document.getElementById("jokerAuthPhone");
if(!email || password.length < 8) {
  status.textContent = "أدخل بريدك الإلكتروني وكلمة مرور من 8 أحرف على الأقل.";
  return;
}
const ph = readAuthPhone();
if(ph.digits && !ph.valid) {
  status.textContent = "رقم الهاتف غير صحيح. أدخل " + jokerAuthCountry.len + " أرقام لرقم " + jokerAuthCountry.name + ".";
  if(phoneInput) phoneInput.focus();
  return;
}
if(btn) btn.disabled = true;
status.textContent = "جارٍ تسجيل الدخول...";
async function savePhoneIfNeeded() {
  if(customerHasPhone || !ph.valid) return;
  const res = await supabaseClient.auth.updateUser({data:{phone: ph.phone}});
  if(!res.error) {
    customerHasPhone = true;
    await refreshAccountState();
    if(pendingCheckoutAfterLogin) {
      pendingCheckoutAfterLogin = false;
      closeAccount();
      openCart();
    }
  }
}
try {
  const {error} = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password});
  if(!error) {
    status.textContent = "تم تسجيل الدخول بنجاح.";
    await refreshAccountState();
    await savePhoneIfNeeded();
    if(!customerHasPhone) status.textContent += " أضف رقم هاتفك في بيانات الحساب حتى نتمكن من التواصل معك بخصوص الطلبات.";
    return;
  }
  const msg = String(error.message || "").toLowerCase();
  if(error.code === "email_not_confirmed" || msg.includes("email not confirmed")) {
    status.textContent = "لم يتم تأكيد بريدك بعد. افتح رسالة التأكيد المرسلة إلى بريدك ثم سجّل الدخول.";
    return;
  }
  if(!(error.code === "invalid_credentials" || msg.includes("invalid login credentials"))) throw error;
  // لا يوجد حساب بهذه البيانات: ننشئ حساباً جديداً تلقائياً (الهاتف مطلوب هنا)
  if(!ph.valid) {
    status.textContent = "لا يوجد حساب بهذا البريد. أدخل رقم هاتفك لإنشاء حسابك وإكمال التسجيل.";
    if(phoneInput) phoneInput.focus();
    return;
  }
  status.textContent = "جارٍ إنشاء حسابك...";
  const res = await supabaseClient.auth.signUp({email,password,options:{data:{phone: ph.phone}}});
  const wrongPassMsg = "كلمة المرور غير صحيحة لهذا البريد. إذا كنت سجّلت سابقاً عبر Google فاستخدم زر Google.";
  if(res.error) {
    if(/already registered|already been registered/i.test(String(res.error.message || ""))) {
      status.textContent = wrongPassMsg;
      return;
    }
    throw res.error;
  }
  const u = res.data && res.data.user;
  if(u && Array.isArray(u.identities) && u.identities.length === 0) {
    status.textContent = wrongPassMsg;
    return;
  }
  if(res.data && res.data.session) {
    status.textContent = "تم إنشاء حسابك وتسجيل دخولك. أهلاً بك في JOKER PLUS.";
    await refreshAccountState();
  } else {
    status.textContent = "تم إنشاء حسابك. افتح رسالة التأكيد المرسلة إلى بريدك ثم سجّل الدخول.";
  }
} catch(error) {
  status.textContent = error.message || "تعذر تسجيل الدخول.";
} finally {
  if(btn) btn.disabled = false;
}
}
async function signOutCustomer() {
const status = document.getElementById("accountStatus");
try {
const {error} = await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
if(error) throw error;
status.textContent = "تم تسجيل الخروج.";
await refreshAccountState();
} catch(error) {
status.textContent = error.message || "تعذر تسجيل الخروج.";
}
}
function optimizeStoreImages(root=document) {
root.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(img => {
if(!img.closest(".hero-banner") && !img.closest(".splash-screen")) {
if(!img.hasAttribute("loading")) img.loading = "lazy";
img.decoding = "async";
}
});
}
function openSharedProductIfRequested() {
const id = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("product");
if(!id) return;
const target = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-product-id]"))
.find(node => node.dataset.productId === id);
if(target) {
target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"center"});
target.classList.add("shared-product-highlight");
} else if(storeItemsCache.some(item => String(item.id) === id && item.section_key === "store")) {
openStoreRegionItems("all");
window.setTimeout(function() {
const found = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#regionItems [data-product-id]")).find(node => node.dataset.productId === id);
if(found) {
found.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"center"});
found.classList.add("shared-product-highlight");
}
},150);
}
}
const CART_STORAGE_KEY = "jokerPlusCartV1";
let cartItems = [];
function readCart() {
try {
const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY) || "[]");
cartItems = Array.isArray(saved) ? saved.filter(item =>
item && typeof item.title === "string" && Number(item.quantity) > 0
) : [];
} catch(error) {
cartItems = [];
}
}
function saveCart() {
try { localStorage.setItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cartItems)); } catch(error) {}
renderCart();
}
function cartPrice(value) {
const normalized = String(value ?? "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,"");
const amount = Number.parseFloat(normalized);
return Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0;
}
function cartButtonKey(button) {
const title = button.dataset.title || "منتج من JOKER PLUS";
const price = button.dataset.price || "";
const productId = button.dataset.productId || "";
return productId || (title + "|" + price);
}
function syncCartAddButtons() {
document.querySelectorAll(".add-cart-button").forEach(button => {
const isInCart = cartItems.some(item => item.key === cartButtonKey(button));
button.disabled = isInCart;
button.textContent = isInCart ? "✓ تمت الإضافة" : "＋ أضف إلى السلة";
button.classList.toggle("is-added",isInCart);
button.setAttribute("aria-disabled",isInCart ? "true" : "false");
const row = button.closest(".cart-add-row");
const picker = row && row.querySelector(".card-qty-picker");
if(picker) {
picker.style.display = isInCart ? "flex" : "none";
const item = cartItems.find(entry => entry.key === cartButtonKey(button));
const value = picker.querySelector(".card-qty-value");
if(value) value.textContent = item ? item.quantity : "1";
}
});
}
function addToCartFromButton(button,event) {
if(event) event.stopPropagation();
const title = button.dataset.title || "منتج من JOKER PLUS";
const price = button.dataset.price || "";
const key = cartButtonKey(button);
if(cartItems.some(item => item.key === key)) {
syncCartAddButtons();
return;
}
cartItems.push({key,title,price,quantity:1});
saveCart();
showCartToast();
const row = button.closest(".cart-add-row");
if(row) {
row.classList.remove("cart-added-pulse");
void row.offsetWidth;
row.classList.add("cart-added-pulse");
}
}
function changeProductCardQuantity(button,delta) {
const row = button.closest(".cart-add-row");
const addButton = row && row.querySelector(".add-cart-button");
if(!addButton) return;
const key = cartButtonKey(addButton);
const index = cartItems.findIndex(item => item.key === key);
if(index < 0) return;
cartItems[index].quantity = Math.min(99, Number(cartItems[index].quantity || 1) + delta);
if(cartItems[index].quantity <= 0) cartItems.splice(index,1);
saveCart();
}
function renderCart() {
const count = cartItems.reduce((sum,item) => sum + Number(item.quantity || 0),0);
const countNode = document.getElementById("cartCount");
const itemsNode = document.getElementById("cartItems");
const totalNode = document.getElementById("cartTotal");
const checkoutNode = document.getElementById("cartCheckout");
if(countNode) countNode.textContent = count;
const fabNode = document.getElementById("cartFab");
if(fabNode) fabNode.hidden = count <= 0;
const navBadge = document.getElementById("navCartBadge");
if(navBadge) {navBadge.textContent = count; navBadge.hidden = count <= 0;}
syncCartAddButtons();
if(!itemsNode || !totalNode || !checkoutNode) return;
if(!cartItems.length) {
itemsNode.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty"><strong>مساحتك الخاصة بانتظار اختياراتك</strong><small>أضف منتجاتك لتبدأ تجربة JOKER PLUS VIP</small></div>';
} else {
itemsNode.innerHTML = cartItems.map((item,index) => `
<div class="cart-row">
<div>
<div class="cart-product-name">${escapeHTML(item.title)}</div>
<div class="cart-product-price">${escapeHTML(item.price || "السعر عند الطلب")} ${item.price ? "د.ك للقطعة" : ""}</div>
</div>
<div class="cart-controls">
<button class="cart-qty-btn" type="button" aria-label="زيادة الكمية" onclick="changeCartQuantity(${index},1)">+</button>
<span class="cart-qty">${Number(item.quantity)}</span>
<button class="cart-qty-btn" type="button" aria-label="تقليل الكمية" onclick="changeCartQuantity(${index},-1)">−</button>
<button class="cart-remove" type="button" aria-label="حذف المنتج" onclick="removeCartItem(${index})">×</button>
</div>
</div>
`).join("");
}
const total = cartItems.reduce((sum,item) => sum + cartPrice(item.price) * Number(item.quantity || 0),0);
const discount = activeJokerCoupon ? calculateJokerDiscount(activeJokerCoupon,total) : 0;
const subtotalNode = document.getElementById("cartSubtotal");
const discountLine = document.getElementById("jokerDiscountLine");
const discountNode = document.getElementById("jokerDiscountAmount");
if(subtotalNode) subtotalNode.textContent = total.toFixed(2) + " د.ك";
if(discountLine) discountLine.hidden = discount <= 0;
if(discountNode) discountNode.textContent = "−" + discount.toFixed(2) + " د.ك";
totalNode.textContent = Math.max(0,total-discount).toFixed(2) + " د.ك";
checkoutNode.disabled = !cartItems.length;
}
function changeCartQuantity(index,delta) {
if(!cartItems[index]) return;
cartItems[index].quantity += delta;
if(cartItems[index].quantity <= 0) cartItems.splice(index,1);
saveCart();
}
function removeCartItem(index) {
cartItems.splice(index,1);
saveCart();
}
function openCart() {
const backdrop = document.getElementById("cartBackdrop");
if(backdrop) {
renderCart();
backdrop.hidden = false;
const panel = backdrop.querySelector(".cart-panel");
if(panel){panel.style.animation="none";void panel.offsetWidth;panel.style.animation="";}
document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
}
}
function closeCart(event) {
if(event && event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
const backdrop = document.getElementById("cartBackdrop");
if(backdrop) backdrop.hidden = true;
document.body.style.overflow = "";
}
let activeJokerCoupon = null;
function currentCartSubtotal() {
return cartItems.reduce((sum,item) => sum + cartPrice(item.price) * Number(item.quantity || 0),0);
}
function calculateJokerDiscount(coupon,subtotal) {
if(!coupon || subtotal <= 0) return 0;
let amount = coupon.discount_type === "percentage" ? subtotal * Number(coupon.discount_value || 0) / 100 : Number(coupon.discount_value || 0);
return Math.min(subtotal,Math.max(0,Math.round(amount * 100) / 100));
}
async function applyJokerCoupon() {
const input = document.getElementById("jokerCouponInput");
const message = document.getElementById("jokerCouponMessage");
const button = document.getElementById("jokerCouponApply");
const code = String(input?.value || "").trim().toUpperCase();
if(!code) { if(message) {message.textContent="اكتب كود الخصم أولاً.";message.className="joker-coupon-message error";} return; }
if(!cartItems.length) { if(message) {message.textContent="أضف المنتجات إلى السلة أولاً.";message.className="joker-coupon-message error";} return; }
if(button) button.disabled = true;
if(message) {message.textContent="جارٍ التحقق من الكوبون...";message.className="joker-coupon-message";}
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_validate_coupon",{p_code:code,p_subtotal:Number(currentCartSubtotal().toFixed(2))});
if(error) throw error;
if(!data || data.valid !== true) throw new Error((data && data.message) || "الكوبون غير صالح أو منتهي.");
activeJokerCoupon = {code,discount_type:data.discount_type,discount_value:Number(data.discount_value),min_order_amount:Number(data.min_order_amount || 0)};
if(message) {message.textContent="تم تفعيل الكوبون " + code + " بنجاح!";message.className="joker-coupon-message success";}
renderCart();
} catch(error) {
activeJokerCoupon = null;
if(message) {message.textContent=(error && error.message) || "تعذر التحقق من الكوبون. تأكد من إعداد SQL.";message.className="joker-coupon-message error";}
renderCart();
} finally {if(button) button.disabled=false;}
}
function removeJokerCoupon() {
activeJokerCoupon = null;
const input=document.getElementById("jokerCouponInput");
const message=document.getElementById("jokerCouponMessage");
if(input) input.value="";
if(message) {message.textContent="تمت إزالة كود الخصم.";message.className="joker-coupon-message";}
renderCart();
}

const splash=document.createElement("div");

splash.innerHTML='<button type="button" aria-label="تخطي" id="jokerReturnSplashSkip" style="position:absolute;top:max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:22px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #c49be5aa;background:#241532;color:#fff;font-size:27px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 0 18px #a77ad044">×</button><div style="max-width:340px"><div style="font-size:42px;margin-bottom:18px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px #c49be5)">✦</div><div style="font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,27px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.9;text-shadow:0 0 20px #a77ad066">شكراً لطلبك<br>جاري تأكيده من قبل الإدارة</div><div style="width:70px;height:3px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#35105c,#c49be5,#a6192e);margin:22px auto 0"></div></div>';

function handleJokerReturnFromWhatsApp() {
try {
if(document.visibilityState === "hidden") return;
if(sessionStorage.getItem("joker_order_pending") !== "1") return;
sessionStorage.removeItem("joker_order_pending");
showJokerReturnSplash();
} catch(_) {}
}
// اكتشاف الرجوع من واتساب تلقائياً، حتى عند العودة للتبويب دون إعادة تحميل الصفحة.
window.addEventListener("pageshow",handleJokerReturnFromWhatsApp);
window.addEventListener("focus",handleJokerReturnFromWhatsApp);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){if(document.visibilityState==="visible") handleJokerReturnFromWhatsApp();});

async function checkoutCart() {
if(!cartItems.length) return;
if(!requireLoginToOrder()) return;
const orderItems = cartItems.map(item => ({title:item.title,quantity:Number(item.quantity || 0),price:item.price || ""}));
const subtotal = Number(currentCartSubtotal().toFixed(2));
const orderNumber = (function(){var map=[["Ag",/فضي|silver/i],["Au",/ذهبي|gold/i],["C",/بلاتين|platinum/i]],pre="";cartItems.some(function(it){var t=String(it.title||"");for(var k=0;k<map.length;k++)if(map[k][1].test(t)){pre=map[k][0];return true}return false});var ts=Date.now().toString();return pre?pre+ts.slice(-12):"JP-"+ts})();
const checkoutNode=document.getElementById("cartCheckout");
if(checkoutNode) {checkoutNode.disabled=true;checkoutNode.textContent="جارٍ تجهيز الطلب...";}
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_create_order_with_coupon",{p_order_number:orderNumber,p_items:orderItems,p_subtotal:subtotal,p_coupon_code:activeJokerCoupon ? activeJokerCoupon.code : null});
if(error) throw error;
if(!data || data.success !== true) throw new Error((data && data.message) || "تعذر تسجيل الطلب.");
// حفظ اسم العميل والبريد والهاتف في سجل الطلب عبر RPC آمن.
// user_id يُستخدم للتحقق من ملكية الطلب داخل قاعدة البيانات فقط ولا يظهر في الفاتورة.
let customerProfile = {full_name:"",email:"",phone:""};
let customerStorageKey = "";
try {
  const sessionResult = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
  const customerUser = sessionResult && sessionResult.data && sessionResult.data.session && sessionResult.data.session.user;
  if(customerUser) {
    customerProfile = {
      full_name: String((customerUser.user_metadata && (customerUser.user_metadata.full_name || customerUser.user_metadata.name)) || "").trim(),
      email: String(customerUser.email || "").trim(),
      phone: String((customerUser.user_metadata && customerUser.user_metadata.phone) || customerUser.phone || "").trim()
    };
    customerStorageKey = customerUser.id ? "jokerPlusLocalPendingOrder_" + customerUser.id : "";
    const profileUpdate = await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_save_order_customer_details", {
      p_order_number: orderNumber,
      p_full_name: customerProfile.full_name || null,
      p_email: customerProfile.email || null,
      p_phone: customerProfile.phone || null
    });
    if(profileUpdate.error) throw profileUpdate.error;
    if(profileUpdate.data !== true) throw new Error("لم يتم العثور على الطلب المرتبط بحسابك لحفظ بيانات الفاتورة.");
  }
} catch(profileError) {
  console.warn("JOKER PLUS: تعذر قراءة بيانات حساب العميل:", profileError && (profileError.message || profileError));
}
// نسخة احتياطية للعرض في «طلباتي» إذا تأخر ظهور السجل من قاعدة البيانات.
try {
  if(customerStorageKey) localStorage.setItem(customerStorageKey, JSON.stringify({status:"pending",total:Number(data.total || 0),items:orderItems,created_at:new Date().toISOString(),full_name:customerProfile.full_name,email:customerProfile.email,phone:customerProfile.phone,local_pending:true}));
} catch(_) {}
// تفريغ السلة بعد نجاح تسجيل الطلب فقط.
cartItems = [];
saveCart();
const finalTotal=Number(data.total || 0);
const discount=Number(data.discount_amount || 0);
const lines = orderItems.map(item => "• " + item.title + " × " + item.quantity + (item.price ? " - " + item.price + " د.ك" : " - السعر عند الطلب"));
const message = "السلام عليكم، أريد طلب المنتجات التالية من JOKER PLUS:\n\n" + lines.join("\n") + "\n\nسيتم ظهور رقم الطلب في الموقع عند تأكيد الطلب من قبل الإدارة." + (data.coupon_code ? "\nكود الخصم: " + data.coupon_code : "") + "\nالمجموع قبل الخصم: " + subtotal.toFixed(2) + " د.ك" + (discount > 0 ? "\nقيمة الخصم: " + discount.toFixed(2) + " د.ك" : "") + "\nالإجمالي بعد الخصم: " + finalTotal.toFixed(2) + " د.ك\nيرجى تأكيد توفر المنتجات.";
const url="https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP_NUMBER + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(message);
// خزّن حالة الطلب قبل فتح واتساب حتى تظهر للعميل عند رجوعه للموقع
try {sessionStorage.setItem("joker_order_pending","1");} catch(_) {}
// تم حفظ حالة الانتظار؛ شاشة العودة ستظهر تلقائياً عند الرجوع من واتساب.
if(activeJokerCoupon) {activeJokerCoupon=null;const input=document.getElementById("jokerCouponInput");if(input) input.value="";}
if(checkoutNode) {checkoutNode.disabled=false;checkoutNode.textContent="إتمام الطلب عبر واتساب";}
renderCart();
// الانتقال مباشرة إلى واتساب في نفس الصفحة؛ يمنع صفحة about:blank البيضاء في Safari/iPhone
window.location.href=url;
} catch(error) {
console.error("JOKER PLUS checkout:",error);
alert((error && error.message) || "تعذر إتمام الطلب. حاول مرة أخرى.");
if(checkoutNode) {checkoutNode.disabled=false;checkoutNode.textContent="إتمام الطلب عبر واتساب";}
}
}
function openSnapArcProductPage(event) {
if(event) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); }
const content = document.getElementById("snapArcProductContent");
if(!content) { console.error("JOKER PLUS: Snap Plus page is missing"); return; }
const snapHeader = document.getElementById("snapArcHeader");
if(snapHeader) snapHeader.hidden = false;
const packageImage = "data:image/webp;base64,";

function renderGameZoneDescription(raw) {
  // The product description is stored with escaped newlines (\\n) in the source data.
  // Normalize both escaped and real line breaks before building the layout.
  const normalized = String(raw || "")
    .replace(/\\r\\n/g, "\n")
    .replace(/\\n/g, "\n")
    .replace(/\\r/g, "\n")
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n");
  const lines = normalized.split("\n").map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const features = [];
  const warranty = [];
  const intro = [];
  let inWarranty = false;
  let note = "";

  lines.forEach(line => {
    if (/شروط وأحكام الضمان|شروط الضمان/.test(line)) {
      inWarranty = true;
      return;
    }
    if (/ملاحظة:/.test(line)) {
      note = line.replace(/^\(?ملاحظة:\s*/, "").replace(/\)?$/, "");
      return;
    }
    if (inWarranty) {
      warranty.push(line.replace(/^\d+[.)]\s*/, ""));
      return;
    }
    const featureMatch = line.match(/^([⚡🔒🎮])\s*([^:：]+)[:：]\s*(.*)$/);
    if (featureMatch) {
      features.push({ icon: featureMatch[1], title: featureMatch[2].trim(), text: featureMatch[3].trim() });
    } else {
      intro.push(line);
    }
  });

  return `<div class="gta6-description-layout">
    ${intro.length ? `<div class="gta6-intro-card">${intro.map(line => `<p>${escapeHTML(line)}</p>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}
    ${features.length ? `<section class="gta6-features" aria-label="مميزات اللعبة"><h3>مميزات العرض</h3><div class="gta6-feature-list">${features.map((item,index) => `<article class="gta6-feature-card"><span class="gta6-feature-icon">${item.icon}</span><div class="gta6-feature-copy"><strong>${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong><p>${escapeHTML(item.text)}</p></div></article>`).join("")}</div></section>` : ""}
    ${warranty.length ? `<section class="gta6-warranty"><div class="gta6-warranty-heading"><span class="gta6-warranty-mark">!</span><div><h3>شروط وأحكام الضمان</h3><p>اقرأ الشروط التالية بعناية للمحافظة على الضمان</p></div></div><ol>${warranty.map(line => `<li>${escapeHTML(line)}</li>`).join("")}</ol>${note ? `<div class="gta6-warranty-note"><strong>تنبيه:</strong> ${escapeHTML(note)}</div>` : ""}</section>` : (note ? `<div class="gta6-warranty-note gta6-standalone-note">${escapeHTML(note)}</div>` : "")}
  </div>`;
}
function createService(item,opts) {
const compact = !!(opts && opts.compact);
const detail = !!(opts && opts.detail);
const isSnapArc = String(item.id || "") === "joker-snaparc-monthly";
const title = String(item.title || "منتج من JOKER PLUS");
const price = String(item.price ?? "");
const descriptionMarkup = item.description ? (item.description_on_click && !detail
? `<button class="product-description-toggle" type="button" onclick="openGameZoneProductDetails('${escapeHTML(String(item.id ?? ""))}',event)">عرض تفاصيل الباقة</button>`
: (detail || !isSnapArc ? (String(item.id || "").startsWith("joker-gta6-") ? renderGameZoneDescription(item.description) : `<div class="service-description">${escapeHTML(item.description)}</div>`) : "")) : "";
if(isSnapArc && !detail) return "";
return `
<div class="service" id="product-${escapeHTML(String(item.id ?? title))}" data-product-id="${escapeHTML(String(item.id ?? ""))}" ${isSnapArc && detail ? 'data-detail="true"' : ""}>
<div class="service-title-row"><div class="service-title">${escapeHTML(title)}</div></div>
${createProductGallery(item)}
${descriptionMarkup}
${item.price ? `<div class="price ${String(item.id || "").startsWith("joker-gta6-") ? "gamezone-gta6-price" : ""}">${escapeHTML(item.price)}${String(item.id || "").startsWith("joker-gta6-") ? " د.ك" : ""}</div>` : ""}
${item.available === false ? `<div class="cart-add-row"><button class="add-cart-button unavailable-btn" type="button" disabled>غير متوفر حالياً</button></div>` : (compact ? `
<div class="cart-add-row">
<div class="card-qty-picker" aria-label="تعديل كمية المنتج">
<button type="button" aria-label="زيادة منتج" onclick="changeProductCardQuantity(this,1)">+</button>
<span class="card-qty-value">1</span>
<button type="button" aria-label="تنقيص منتج" onclick="changeProductCardQuantity(this,-1)">−</button>
</div>
<button class="add-cart-button" type="button"
data-title="${escapeHTML(title)}"
data-price="${escapeHTML(price)}"
data-product-id="${escapeHTML(String(item.id ?? ""))}"
onclick="addToCartFromButton(this,event)">
＋ أضف إلى السلة
</button>
</div>` : `      <div class="cart-add-row">
<button class="add-cart-button" type="button"
data-title="${escapeHTML(title)}"
data-price="${escapeHTML(price)}"
data-product-id="${escapeHTML(String(item.id ?? ""))}"
onclick="addToCartFromButton(this,event)">
＋ أضف إلى السلة
</button>
<div class="card-qty-picker" aria-label="تعديل كمية المنتج">
<button type="button" aria-label="زيادة منتج" onclick="changeProductCardQuantity(this,1)">+</button>
<span class="card-qty-value">1</span>
<button type="button" aria-label="تنقيص منتج" onclick="changeProductCardQuantity(this,-1)">−</button>
</div>
</div>
`)}
</div>
`;
}
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(event){
const card = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('.section-card.section-games[role="button"]') : null;
if(card && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
event.preventDefault();
openSnapArcProductPage(event);
}
const gameZoneCard = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('.section-card.section-gamezone[role="button"]') : null;
if(gameZoneCard && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
event.preventDefault();
openGameZoneProductsPage(event);
}
});

function createSection(section,items,images) {
const sectionImage = images.find(image => image.section === section.id);
const sectionItems = items.filter(item => item.section_key === section.id);
return `
<article class="section-card section-${section.id}"
${section.id === "apps"
? 'onclick="openPlusPackages(event)"'
: section.id === "store"
? 'onclick="openStoreRegions(event)"'
: section.id === "gamezone"
? 'role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="فتح منتجات عالم الألعاب" onclick="openGameZoneProductsPage(event)"'
: section.id === "games"
? 'role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="فتح قسم سناب بلس" onclick="openSnapArcProductPage(event)"'
: (!sectionItems.length ? 'onclick="openUnavailableSection(event)"' : '')}>
${createPhone(section,sectionImage?.image_url)}
<h3>${escapeHTML(section.id === "games" ? "سناب بلس" : section.name)}</h3>
<p class="section-description">${escapeHTML(section.id === "games" ? "الباقات اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية" : section.description)}</p>
<div class="services">
${
sectionItems.length && section.id !== "store" && section.id !== "games" && section.id !== "gamezone"
? sectionItems.map(createService).join("")
: ""
}
</div>
</article>
`;
}
function openPlusPackages(event) {
if(event && event.target.closest("a,button,summary,details")) return;
const storePage = document.getElementById("storePage");
const packagesPage = document.getElementById("packagesPage");
storePage.hidden = true;
packagesPage.hidden = false;
window.scrollTo({
top:0,
behavior:"instant"
});
}
function backToStore() {
const storePage = document.getElementById("storePage");
const packagesPage = document.getElementById("packagesPage");
packagesPage.hidden = true;
storePage.hidden = false;
window.scrollTo({
top:0,
behavior:"instant"
});
}
function openUnavailableSection(event) {
if(event && event.target.closest("a,button,summary,details")) return;
document.getElementById("storePage").hidden = true;
document.getElementById("packagesPage").hidden = true;
document.getElementById("noticePage").hidden = false;
window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"instant"});
}
function backFromNotice() {
document.getElementById("noticePage").hidden = true;
document.getElementById("storePage").hidden = false;
window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"instant"});
}

function loadPackages() {
const container = document.getElementById("plusPackages");

function applyStorePriceMarkup(item) {
if (!item || item.section_key !== "store" || item.price === null || item.price === undefined || item.price === "") return item;
var amount = Number(String(item.price).replace(/,/g, ""));
if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) return item;
return Object.assign({}, item, {price: (amount + 0.250).toFixed(3)});
}
async function loadStore() {
const container = document.getElementById("sections");
try {
const [itemsResult,imagesResult] = await Promise.all([
supabaseClient.from("store_items").select("*").eq("active",true).order("sort_order",{ascending:true}),
supabaseClient.from("section_images").select("*")
]);
if(itemsResult.error) throw new Error("خطأ المنتجات: " + itemsResult.error.message);
if(imagesResult.error) throw new Error("خطأ صور الأقسام: " + imagesResult.error.message);
const items = (itemsResult.data || []).map(applyStorePriceMarkup);
// باقة سناب آرك الشهرية — منتج مدمج ضمن قسم أكواد سناب.
window.snapArcProduct = {
 id: "joker-snaparc-monthly",

function reorderCustomerOrder(btn){let a=[];try{a=JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(btn.dataset.items||"%5B%5D"))}catch(_){}if(!Array.isArray(a)||!a.length){alert("تفاصيل المنتجات غير متوفرة لهذا الطلب.");return}a.forEach(x=>{const title=String(x.title||x.name||"منتج"),key=String(x.product_id||x.id||(title+"|"+(x.price||""))),q=Math.max(1,Math.min(99,Number(x.quantity||1))),old=cartItems.find(y=>y.key===key);if(old)old.quantity=Math.min(99,old.quantity+q);else cartItems.push({key,title,price:String(x.price||""),quantity:q})});saveCart();openCart()}

function jokerScrollToNavSection(selector,navName) {
  if(typeof closeInfoPage === "function") closeInfoPage();
  if(typeof closeCart === "function") closeCart();
  const target=document.querySelector(selector);
  if(!target) { setActiveNav("home"); return; }
  setActiveNav(navName);
  const top=target.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.pageYOffset-92;
  window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,top),behavior:window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches?"auto":"smooth"});
  target.classList.remove("joker-nav-focus");
  void target.offsetWidth;
  target.classList.add("joker-nav-focus");
  window.setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove("joker-nav-focus"),1100);
}
function navGo(name) {
  if(typeof closeAccount === "function") closeAccount();
  if(name !== "cart" && typeof closeCart === "function") closeCart();
  if(name === "home") {
    closeInfoPage();
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});
    setActiveNav("home");
    return;
  }
  if(name === "packages") { jokerScrollToNavSection(".section-apps","packages"); return; }
  if(name === "games") { jokerScrollToNavSection(".section-gamezone","games"); return; }
  if(name === "store") { jokerScrollToNavSection(".section-store","store"); return; }
  if(name === "cart") { openCart(); setActiveNav("cart"); }
  else if(name === "orders") {
    openInfoPage("ordersPage");
    setActiveNav("orders");
    loadCustomerOrders();
  } else if(name === "search") {
    openInfoPage("searchPage");
    setActiveNav("search");
    const input = document.getElementById("storeSearchInput");
    if(input) window.setTimeout(function() {input.focus();},60);
  }
}

function copyOrderNumber(button) {
const number = button.dataset.number || "";
const done = function() {
const old = button.textContent;
button.textContent = "✓";
window.setTimeout(function() {button.textContent = old;},1200);
};
if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
navigator.clipboard.writeText(number).then(done).catch(function() {});
}
}
function normalizeSearchText(value) {
return String(value || "").toLowerCase()
.replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u0640]/g,"")
.replace(/[أإآ]/g,"ا").replace(/ة/g,"ه").replace(/ى/g,"ي").trim();
}
function runStoreSearch() {
const input = document.getElementById("storeSearchInput");
const box = document.getElementById("storeSearchResults");
if(!input || !box) return;
const query = normalizeSearchText(input.value);
if(!query) {
box.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">اكتب اسم المنتج أو الباقة للبحث.</p>';
return;
}
const results = [];
storeItemsCache.forEach(function(item) {
const hay = normalizeSearchText((item.title || "") + " " + (item.description || ""));
if(hay.indexOf(query) !== -1) {
results.push({kind:"item",section:String(item.section_key || ""),id:String(item.id ?? ""),title:String(item.title || "منتج"),price:item.price ? String(item.price) : ""});
}
});
(typeof packagesData !== "undefined" ? packagesData : []).forEach(function(pack) {
const hay = normalizeSearchText((pack.name || "") + " " + (pack.label || "") + " تطبيقات بلس");
if(hay.indexOf(query) !== -1) {
results.push({kind:"pack",id:String(pack.id ?? pack.name),title:pack.name + " - تطبيقات بلس",price:String(pack.price || "")});
}
});
if(!results.length) {
box.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">ما لقينا نتائج مطابقة.</p>';
return;
}
box.innerHTML = results.slice(0,30).map(function(r) {
return '<button type="button" class="store-search-item" data-kind="' + r.kind + '" data-section="' + escapeHTML(r.section || "") + '" data-id="' + escapeHTML(r.id) + '" onclick="openSearchResult(this)">' +
'<span>' + escapeHTML(r.title) + '</span>' +
(r.price ? '<span class="store-search-price">' + escapeHTML(r.price) + ' د.ك</span>' : '') +
'</button>';
}).join("");
}
function openSearchResult(button) {
const kind = button.dataset.kind;
const id = button.dataset.id;
if(kind === "pack") {
openInfoPage("packagesPage");
return;
}
if(button.dataset.section === "store") openStoreRegionItems("all"); else closeInfoPage();
window.setTimeout(function() {
const target = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-product-id]")).find(function(node) {
return node.dataset.productId === id;
});
if(target) {
target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"center"});
target.classList.add("shared-product-highlight");
window.setTimeout(function() {target.classList.remove("shared-product-highlight");},3500);
}
},120);
}

async function checkAdminAccess(session) {
const btn = document.getElementById("adminBtn");
if(!btn) return;
if(!session) {
isAdminUser = false;
btn.hidden = true;
const pg = document.getElementById("adminPage");
if(pg && !pg.hidden) closeInfoPage();
return;
}
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.rpc("is_admin");
isAdminUser = !error && data === true;
} catch(error) {
isAdminUser = false;
}
btn.hidden = !isAdminUser;
if(isAdminUser) refreshAdminBadge();
}
supabaseClient.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
checkAdminAccess(result && result.data ? result.data.session : null);
}).catch(function() {});
function updateAdminBadge() {
const badge = document.getElementById("adminBadge");
if(!badge) return;
const pending = adminOrdersCache.filter(o => String(o.status || "").trim() === "بانتظار تأكيد الطلب").length;
badge.textContent = pending;
badge.hidden = pending <= 0;
}
async function refreshAdminBadge() {
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.rpc("admin_list_orders");
if(error) throw error;
adminOrdersCache = data || [];
updateAdminBadge();
} catch(error) {}
}
function showAdminSection(section) {

const current = ["reviews","coupons","products"].includes(section) ? section : "orders";
const sections={orders:"adminOrdersSection",coupons:"adminCouponsSection",reviews:"adminReviewsSection",products:"adminProductsSection"};
const tabs={orders:"adminOrdersTab",coupons:"adminCouponsTab",reviews:"adminReviewsTab",products:"adminProductsTab"};
Object.keys(sections).forEach(function(key){const el=document.getElementById(sections[key]);if(el) el.hidden=key!==current;const tab=document.getElementById(tabs[key]);if(tab){tab.classList.toggle("active",key===current);tab.setAttribute("aria-selected",key===current?"true":"false");}});
if(current==="reviews") loadAdminReviews();
if(current==="coupons") loadAdminCoupons();
if(current==="products") loadAdminProducts();
}

function formatAdminKwd(value){const n=Number(value)||0;return n.toFixed(3);}
function renderAdminDashboardStats(){
 const rows=Array.isArray(adminOrdersCache)?adminOrdersCache:[];
 const completed=rows.filter(o=>String(o.status||"").trim()==="تم التنفيذ");
 const pending=rows.filter(o=>String(o.status||"").trim()==="بانتظار تأكيد الطلب");
 const gross=rows.reduce((a,o)=>a+(Number(o.total)||0),0);
 const revenue=completed.reduce((a,o)=>a+(Number(o.total)||0),0);
 const customers=new Set(rows.map(o=>o.user_id||o.email||o.phone).filter(Boolean));
 const set=(id,value)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.textContent=value;};
 set("statOrders",rows.length.toLocaleString("ar-KW"));set("statRevenue",formatAdminKwd(revenue));set("statPending",pending.length.toLocaleString("ar-KW"));set("statCompleted",completed.length.toLocaleString("ar-KW"));set("statAverage",formatAdminKwd(completed.length?revenue/completed.length:0));set("statCustomers",customers.size.toLocaleString("ar-KW"));set("statGross",formatAdminKwd(gross));
 renderJokerCommandCenter();
}
async function refreshAdminDashboard(){
 if(!isAdminUser)return;
 const msg=document.getElementById("adminStatsMsg");
 const setStat=(id,value)=>{const node=document.getElementById(id);if(node)node.textContent=value;};
 const fmt=(value)=>Number(value||0).toLocaleString("ar-KW",{minimumFractionDigits:0,maximumFractionDigits:3});
 try{
  const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.rpc("admin_dashboard_stats");
  if(error)throw error;
  const stats=data&&typeof data==="object"?data:{};
  const total=Number(stats.total_orders)||0;
  const completed=Number(stats.completed_orders)||0;
  const pending=Number(stats.pending_orders)||0;
  const revenue=Number(stats.revenue)||0;
  const gross=Number(stats.gross)||0;
  const customers=Number(stats.customers)||0;
  setStat("statOrders",fmt(total));
  setStat("statRevenue",formatAdminKwd(revenue));
  setStat("statPending",fmt(pending));
  setStat("statCompleted",fmt(completed));
  setStat("statAverage",formatAdminKwd(completed?revenue/completed:0));
  setStat("statCustomers",fmt(customers));
  setStat("statGross",formatAdminKwd(gross));
  const activeProducts=Number(stats.active_products);
  if(Number.isFinite(activeProducts)){
   const grid=document.getElementById("adminStatsGrid");
   let card=document.getElementById("statActiveProducts");
   if(grid&&!card){card=document.createElement("div");card.className="admin-stat-card";card.innerHTML='<span>المنتجات النشطة</span><strong id="statActiveProducts">—</strong><small>منتجات ظاهرة في المتجر</small>';grid.appendChild(card);}
   setStat("statActiveProducts",fmt(activeProducts));
  }
  if(msg)msg.textContent="تم جلب مؤشرات لوحة التحكم مباشرة من قاعدة البيانات.";
 }catch(e){
  renderAdminDashboardStats();
  if(msg)msg.textContent="تعذر جلب المؤشرات المباشرة: "+String((e&&(e.message||e.code))||e)+". يتم عرض ملخص الطلبات المحمّلة مؤقتاً.";
 }
 const v=document.getElementById("statVisitors"),note=document.getElementById("statVisitorsNote");
 try{const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_admin_visit_count");if(error)throw error;const count=typeof data==="number"?data:Number(data&&data.visitors);if(v&&Number.isFinite(count))v.textContent=count.toLocaleString("ar-KW");if(note)note.textContent="زوار فريدون حسب اليوم";}
 catch(e){if(v)v.textContent="—";if(note)note.textContent="عداد الزيارات غير متاح حالياً";}
 renderJokerCommandCenter();
}
async function loadAdminOrders() {
const box = document.getElementById("adminOrders");
if(!box) return;
box.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">جارٍ تحميل الطلبات...</p>';
try {
const {data,error} = await supabaseClient.rpc("admin_list_orders");
if(error) throw error;
adminOrdersCache = data || [];
// دمج بيانات الطلب الكاملة حتى تظهر بيانات العميل والمنتجات في الفاتورة الحالية.
try {
 const details = await supabaseClient.from("orders").select("*").order("created_at",{ascending:false}).limit(200);
 if(!details.error && Array.isArray(details.data)) {
  const byNo = new Map(details.data.map(function(o){return [String(o.order_number||""),o]}));
  adminOrdersCache = adminOrdersCache.map(function(o){var d=byNo.get(String(o.order_number||""));return d?Object.assign({},o,d,{status:o.status||d.status}):o});
 }
} catch(_) {}
renderAdminOrders();
renderAdminDashboardStats();
} catch(error) {
box.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">تعذر تحميل الطلبات.<br><small dir="ltr">' + escapeHTML(String((error && (error.message || error.code)) || error)) + '</small></p>';
}
}
function renderAdminOrders() {
const box = document.getElementById("adminOrders");
if(!box) return;
updateAdminBadge();
document.querySelectorAll("#adminFilters button").forEach(function(b) {
b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.filter === adminFilter);
});
const list = adminOrdersCache.filter(o => adminFilter === "all" || String(o.status || "").trim() === adminFilter).sort(function(a,b){return (String(a.status||"").trim()==="تم التنفيذ"?1:0)-(String(b.status||"").trim()==="تم التنفيذ"?1:0)});
if(!list.length) {
box.innerHTML = '<p class="account-hint">ما فيه طلبات بهذي الحالة.</p>';
return;
}
box.innerHTML = list.map(function(o) {
const number = String(o.order_number || "—");
const current = String(o.status || "").trim();
const items = Array.isArray(o.items) ? o.items : [];
const itemsHtml = items.map(function(it) {
return escapeHTML(String(it.title || "")) + " × " + escapeHTML(String(it.quantity || 1));
}).join("<br>");
const totalNumber = Number(o.total);
const totalText = isNaN(totalNumber) ? "—" : totalNumber.toFixed(2) + " د.ك";
const date = o.created_at ? new Date(o.created_at).toLocaleString("ar-KW") : "—";
const phoneDigits = String(o.phone || "").replace(/[^0-9]/g,"");
const customer = escapeHTML(String(o.full_name || "بدون اسم")) +
(o.email ? " — " + escapeHTML(String(o.email)) : "") +
(phoneDigits ? ' — <a href="https://wa.me/' + phoneDigits + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">+' + phoneDigits + '</a>' : "");
const buttons = ADMIN_STATUSES.map(function(st) {
return '<button type="button" class="admin-status-btn' + (current === st.value ? " active" : "") + '" data-order="' + escapeHTML(number) + '" data-status="' + escapeHTML(st.value) + '" onclick="setAdminOrderStatus(this)">' + escapeHTML(st.label) + '</button>';
}).join("");
return '<article class="admin-order' + (current === 'تم التنفيذ' ? ' admin-order-done' : '') + '" data-order-no="' + escapeHTML(number) + '">' +

async function saveAdminCoupon() {
if(!isAdminUser) return;
const msg=document.getElementById("adminCouponsMsg");
const code=String(document.getElementById("adminCouponCode").value||"").trim().toUpperCase();
const type=document.getElementById("adminCouponType").value;
const value=Number(document.getElementById("adminCouponValue").value);
const min=Number(document.getElementById("adminCouponMin").value||0);
const usesRaw=document.getElementById("adminCouponUses").value;
const maxUses=usesRaw===""?null:Number(usesRaw);
const expiryRaw=document.getElementById("adminCouponExpiry").value;
const expiry=expiryRaw?new Date(expiryRaw).toISOString():null;
const active=document.getElementById("adminCouponActive").checked;
if(!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,40}$/.test(code)){if(msg) msg.textContent="اكتب كوداً من 3 إلى 40 حرفاً أو رقماً.";return;}
if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value<=0||(type==="percentage"&&value>100)||!Number.isFinite(min)||min<0||(maxUses!==null&&(!Number.isInteger(maxUses)||maxUses<1))){if(msg) msg.textContent="راجع قيمة الخصم والحد الأدنى وعدد الاستخدامات.";return;}
const btn=document.querySelector(".joker-coupon-save");if(btn) btn.disabled=true;if(msg) msg.textContent="جارٍ حفظ الكوبون...";
try{const {error}=await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_admin_save_coupon",{p_code:code,p_discount_type:type,p_discount_value:value,p_min_order_amount:min,p_max_uses:maxUses,p_expires_at:expiry,p_is_active:active});if(error) throw error;if(msg) msg.textContent="تم حفظ الكوبون بنجاح.";document.getElementById("adminCouponCode").value="";document.getElementById("adminCouponValue").value="";document.getElementById("adminCouponUses").value="";document.getElementById("adminCouponExpiry").value="";await loadAdminCoupons();}catch(error){if(msg) msg.textContent="تعذر حفظ الكوبون: "+((error&&error.message)||String(error));}finally{if(btn) btn.disabled=false;}
}
async function toggleAdminCoupon(index) {

if(!c) return;
const msg=document.getElementById("adminCouponsMsg");
const nextActive=!Boolean(c.is_active);

const {error}=await supabaseClient.rpc("joker_admin_save_coupon",{
p_code:c.code,
p_discount_type:c.discount_type,
p_discount_value:Number(c.discount_value),
p_min_order_amount:Number(c.min_order_amount||0),
p_max_uses:c.max_uses===null?null:Number(c.max_uses),
p_expires_at:c.expires_at||null,
p_is_active:nextActive
});
if(error) throw error;
if(msg) msg.textContent=nextActive?"تم تفعيل الكوبون بنجاح.":"تم إيقاف الكوبون بنجاح.";

} catch(error) {
if(msg) msg.textContent="تعذر تغيير حالة الكوبون: "+((error&&error.message)||String(error));
}
}

function itemMatchesRegion(item, region) {
const text = normalizeSearchText((item.title || "") + " " + (item.description || ""));
return region.keys.some(function(k) {
const key = normalizeSearchText(k);
if(/^[a-z]+$/.test(key)) return new RegExp("(^|[^a-z])" + key + "([^a-z]|$)").test(text);
return text.indexOf(key) !== -1;
});
}

<script id="joker-signature-touches-script">
(function () {
"use strict";
function setupJokerReveals() {
if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window) ||
window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
var targets = document.querySelectorAll(
".hero-banner, .section-heading, .section-card, .package-card"
);
if (!targets.length) return;
document.body.classList.add("joker-motion-ready");
var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
entries.forEach(function (entry) {
if (entry.isIntersecting) {
entry.target.classList.add("joker-revealed");
observer.unobserve(entry.target);
}
});
}, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: "0px 0px -24px 0px" });
targets.forEach(function (element) {
element.classList.add("joker-reveal");
observer.observe(element);
});
}
function setupJokerTouchFlash() {
if (!window.matchMedia ||
window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {
if (event.pointerType !== "touch" || !event.isPrimary) return;
var flash = document.createElement("span");
flash.className = "joker-touch-flash";
flash.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
flash.style.left = event.clientX + "px";
flash.style.top = event.clientY + "px";
document.body.appendChild(flash);
flash.addEventListener("animationend", function () {
if (flash.parentNode) flash.parentNode.removeChild(flash);
}, { once: true });
}, { passive: true });
}
function setupJokerProductGlow() {
if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
var card = event.target.closest(".service, .package-card");
if (!card || event.target.closest("button,a,input,summary")) return;
card.classList.remove("joker-product-glow");
void card.offsetWidth;
card.classList.add("joker-product-glow");
window.setTimeout(function(){card.classList.remove("joker-product-glow")},950);
});
}

setupJokerReveals();

<script id="joker-coming-soon-countdown">
(function () {
"use strict";
var launchAt = new Date("2026-12-18T21:50:00+03:00").getTime();
var ids = {
days: document.getElementById("jokerDays"),
hours: document.getElementById("jokerHours"),
minutes: document.getElementById("jokerMinutes"),
seconds: document.getElementById("jokerSeconds"),
status: document.getElementById("jokerCountdownStatus")
};
if (!ids.days || !ids.hours || !ids.minutes || !ids.seconds) return;
function pad(value) { return String(value).padStart(2, "0"); }
function tick() {
var remaining = launchAt - Date.now();
if (remaining <= 0) {
ids.days.textContent = "00";
ids.hours.textContent = "00";
ids.minutes.textContent = "00";
ids.seconds.textContent = "00";
if (ids.status) ids.status.textContent = "وصل موعد الإطلاق — ترقبوا خدمات الجوكر!";
window.clearInterval(timer);
return;
}
var days = Math.floor(remaining / 86400000);
var hours = Math.floor((remaining % 86400000) / 3600000);
var minutes = Math.floor((remaining % 3600000) / 60000);
var seconds = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
ids.days.textContent = pad(days);
ids.hours.textContent = pad(hours);
ids.minutes.textContent = pad(minutes);
ids.seconds.textContent = pad(seconds);
}
tick();
var timer = window.setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

(function () {

function chooseRating(value) {

function renderReviews(rows) {
if (typeof list._jokerAutoStop === "function") list._jokerAutoStop();
list.replaceChildren();
if (!rows || !rows.length) {
var empty = document.createElement("div");
empty.className = "joker-review-empty";
empty.textContent = "";
list.appendChild(empty);
summary.hidden = true;
return;
}

summary.hidden = false;

score.textContent = average.toFixed(1) + "/5";
var stars = document.createElement("span");

head.append(identity, rating);
card.append(head, body);
list.appendChild(card);
});
if (rows.length > 1) {
list.classList.add("joker-review-marquee");
// Duplicate the cards to create a continuous horizontal loop.
Array.from(list.children).forEach(function (card) {
var clone = card.cloneNode(true);
clone.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
clone.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
list.appendChild(clone);
});
var autoFrame = 0;
var resumeTimer = null;
var lastFrame = 0;
var dragging = false;
var dragPointerId = null;
var dragStartX = 0;
var dragStartScroll = 0;
var loopWidth = 0;
function measureLoop() {
loopWidth = list.scrollWidth / 2;
}
function stopAuto() {
if (autoFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(autoFrame);
autoFrame = 0;
lastFrame = 0;
if (resumeTimer) clearTimeout(resumeTimer);
resumeTimer = null;
}
function startAuto() {
if (autoFrame || dragging || list.scrollWidth <= list.clientWidth + 2) return;
measureLoop();
lastFrame = 0;
function step(timestamp) {
if (!list.isConnected || dragging) { autoFrame = 0; return; }
if (!lastFrame) lastFrame = timestamp;
var elapsed = Math.min(40, timestamp - lastFrame);
lastFrame = timestamp;
// LTR scrolling keeps the loop direction consistent in Arabic layouts.
list.scrollLeft += elapsed * 0.07;
if (loopWidth > 0 && list.scrollLeft >= loopWidth) list.scrollLeft -= loopWidth;
if (list.scrollLeft < 0) list.scrollLeft = 0;
autoFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
autoFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
function pauseAndResume(delay) {
stopAuto();
if (!dragging) resumeTimer = setTimeout(startAuto, delay || 2400);
}
// Native touch scrolling works on phones; pointer dragging adds mouse support.
list.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {
stopAuto();
if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button === 0) {
dragging = true;
dragPointerId = event.pointerId;
dragStartX = event.clientX;
dragStartScroll = list.scrollLeft;
list.classList.add("is-dragging");
try { list.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
}
}, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
if (!dragging || event.pointerId !== dragPointerId) return;
list.scrollLeft = dragStartScroll + (dragStartX - event.clientX);
}, { passive: true });
function finishDrag(event) {
if (dragging && (!event || event.pointerId === dragPointerId)) {
dragging = false;
dragPointerId = null;
list.classList.remove("is-dragging");
pauseAndResume(1800);
}
}
list.addEventListener("pointerup", finishDrag, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("pointercancel", finishDrag, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", finishDrag, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("touchstart", function () { stopAuto(); }, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("touchend", function () { pauseAndResume(2200); }, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("touchcancel", function () { pauseAndResume(2200); }, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("wheel", function () { pauseAndResume(1800); }, { passive: true });
list.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
if (!dragging && !autoFrame) pauseAndResume(1800);
}, { passive: true });
if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
var resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(function () { measureLoop(); });
resizeObserver.observe(list);
list._jokerResizeObserver = resizeObserver;
}
list._jokerAutoStop = function () {
stopAuto();
if (list._jokerResizeObserver) list._jokerResizeObserver.disconnect();
};
measureLoop();
startAuto();
}
}
async function loadReviews() {
if (!client) {
list.textContent = "تعذر الاتصال بخدمة التقييمات. تحقق من إعداد Supabase.";
return;
}
var result = await client.from("customer_reviews")
.select("id,rating,comment,created_at")
.eq("is_approved", true)
.order("created_at", { ascending: false })
.limit(30);
if (result.error) {
console.error("JOKER reviews load error:", result.error);
list.textContent = "تعذر تحميل التقييمات حالياً. تأكد من تنفيذ إعداد قاعدة البيانات.";
return;
}
renderReviews(result.data || []);
}
form.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {
event.preventDefault();
var text = comment.value.trim();
if (!selectedRating) { setMessage("اختر عدد النجوم أولاً.", true); return; }
if (text.length < 3 || text.length > 500) { setMessage("اكتب تعليقاً من 3 إلى 500 حرف.", true); return; }
if (!client) { setMessage("خدمة التقييمات غير مهيأة بعد. نفّذ إعداد Supabase المرفق.", true); return; }
submit.disabled = true;
submit.textContent = "جارٍ إرسال تقييمك…";
setMessage("لحظة، يتم إرسال تقييمك بأمان…", false);
var result = await client.from("customer_reviews").insert({ rating: selectedRating, comment: text });
submit.disabled = false;
submit.textContent = "إرسال التقييم";
if (result.error) {
console.error("JOKER review submit error:", result.error);
setMessage("لم نتمكن من إرسال التقييم. تأكد من إعداد قاعدة البيانات ثم حاول مجدداً.", true);
return;
}
form.reset();
chooseRating(0);
setMessage("وصلنا تقييمك، شكراً لك!", false);
await loadReviews();
});
window.jokerReloadPublicReviews = loadReviews;
loadReviews();
})();

<script id="joker-scroll-top">
(function(){
"use strict";
try{if("scrollRestoration" in history)history.scrollRestoration="manual";}catch(_){}
try{sessionStorage.removeItem("jokerScrollY");}catch(_){}
var userMoved=false;
["touchstart","wheel","keydown","mousedown"].forEach(function(e){
  window.addEventListener(e,function(){userMoved=true;},{passive:true,once:true});
});
function toTop(){
  if(userMoved)return;
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  if(document.documentElement)document.documentElement.scrollTop=0;
  if(document.body)document.body.scrollTop=0;
}
toTop();
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",toTop);
window.addEventListener("load",function(){
  toTop();
  var n=0;
  (function again(){toTop();if(++n<12&&!userMoved)setTimeout(again,150);})();
});
window.addEventListener("pageshow",function(e){if(e.persisted){userMoved=false;toTop();}});
})();
</script>

window.compressJokerProductImage=function(file){
 return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
  if(!file){resolve("");return;}
  if(!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type)){reject(new Error("صيغة الصورة غير مدعومة."));return;}
  if(file.size>8*1024*1024){reject(new Error("حجم الصورة أكبر من 8 ميغابايت."));return;}
  var reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onerror=function(){reject(new Error("تعذر قراءة الصورة."));};
  reader.onload=function(){
   var img=new Image();
   img.onerror=function(){reject(new Error("ملف الصورة غير صالح."));};
   img.onload=function(){
    var scale=Math.min(1,1100/Math.max(img.width,img.height));
    var canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.height*scale));
    var ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    resolve(canvas.toDataURL("image/webp",0.76));
   };
   img.src=reader.result;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
 });
};

 if(!id)payload.sort_order=Date.now();
 if(save)save.disabled=true;

function convertJokerAdminDigits(root){
 if(!root)return;
 var walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),node;
 while((node=walker.nextNode())){var next=jokerEnglishDigits(node.nodeValue);if(next!==node.nodeValue)node.nodeValue=next;}

}

}
